_purpose: Machine-readable ASHRAE 140-2023 Section 9.2 CE100-CE200 space-cooling equipment case definitions. GENERATED by scripts/generate_section9_ce_cases.py - do not hand-edit; regenerate. Issue #4296.
_original_identifiers: IEA SHC Task 22 published this family as E100-E200; ASHRAE 140 renamed it CE100-CE200 when the cases entered the standard (140-2023). Same cases, new names - the tree uses the 140 names

_parameter_source.citation: NatLabRockies/BESTEST-GSR, measures/bestest_ce_reporting, shared_resources/bestest_case_var_lib.rb bestest_5_3_case_defs(); NREL reference implementation of ASHRAE 140 Section 9 (EnergyPlus), BSD-style license; parameters derived from the ASHRAE Std140_CE_a_Files/Normative Materials supplemental package
_parameter_source.retrieved: 2026-10-18 from the BESTEST-GSR working copy at /tmp/BESTEST-GSR
_parameter_source.note: Upstream case-title typos (CE165 'Variatino fo', CE195 'Rato') corrected; numeric parameters transcribed unchanged

performance_map.point_count_note: 6 ODB rows x 4 EWB columns per transcribed table

fan_heat.net_definition: gross capacities with the manufacturer default fan heat of 329 W deducted
fan_heat.adjusted_net_definition: gross capacities with the actual fan heat of 230 W deducted

acceptance_policy: Each case carries two explicitly labelled band slots: 'analytical' (the §9.2 quasi-analytical criterion - null today, the 140-2023 §9 normative materials are licensed, Issue #4285) and 'comparative' (the IEA SHC Task 22 ensemble evidence range, read per case from tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/data/comparative_bounds_ce100_ce200.csv). Every band records its own source; no band is fitted to the engine output, no band is widened, and no flat percentage is applied across cases.

engine_coverage.note: Every CE case is dispatched through the DX performance map by the §9 engine-run harness (tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/section9_engine_run.rs); the per-case band rows (comparative, Task-22 ensemble bounds) and their known-fail status are recorded in tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/data/section9_engine_run_results.json (KNOWN_ISSUES LIMIT-42). The analytical §9.2 acceptance slot stays null (the 140-2023 §9 normative materials are licensed, Issue #4285) and the normative CE weather files are not committed (Issue #4285 / methodology F1), so the annual band metrics are not reproducible from the steady-state run
